During normal operation, the power-ON LED on the front of the power supply and the Start and Transfer LEDs on the 
control board illuminate. When a problem occurs with the system, one or more of the fault LEDs on the front of the power 
supply and the Error LED or the Reset LED on the control board may illuminate or blink.

Use the control board Reset and Error LEDs to troubleshoot

The Reset and Error LEDs provide information to use when troubleshooting a system failure. If the LEDs on the front of 
the power supply are blinking, count the number of times the Error LED blinks. Then, look at Table 5 on page 77 to 
determine the corrective action.
[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_179b2e217f2d3235b8ebe61bb355]]
Reset LED

tests at J7 on the power board. See Test 2 – power board voltage checks on page 84.
[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_1c9975c844062b401fbee0edc878]]

Test pin 5 to ground for 3.3 VDC (±10%).
[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_a2f1dd600588986d3c2b344b4851]]

Test pin 7 to ground for 5 VDC (±10%).
[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_14cda188197820f3eb69e0e0144b]]

Test pin 12 to ground for 2.2 VDC (±10%).
[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_5985eff252fa2b58469af0bd7af0]]

perform the tests again. If you find the correct values the second time, replace the control board. Otherwise, replace the 
power board. See Replace the control board on page 126 or Replace the power board on page 135.
